text:
sophia: Quick heads-up: rolling out two new Dedicated A2 pools for low-cost inference in nordic and canada regions: `dedicated-a2-eu-north-1a` and `dedicated-a2-ca-central-1a`.

sophia: These are targeted at lightweight production workloads (embeddings, short-response chat, small rerankers). Initial capacity: eu-north-1a = 20 cards, ca-central-1a = 12 cards. Pilot window = 7 days; we'll scale after monitoring.

devrel: Any change to reservation terms or defaults?

sophia: Yes 1) new minimum reservation term for A2 pools = 7d (was 1d for other pools) to reduce churn. 2) Soft preemption guard applied: cross-tenant burst uses compute-credits which are consumed before evicting reserved slots.

ops: Can you explain compute-credits briefly?

sophia: Compute-credits are a soft-burst token bucket per pool. Default grant = 10 credits per tenant per day; each short allocation consumes credits. If tenant runs out, their burst requests are deprioritized but not immediately evicted. Ops + Sales can request temporary credit top-ups for customers during onboarding.

finance: Pricing delta vs standard Dedicated? Need numbers for quotes.

sophia: High-level guidance: A2 unit cost ~70% lower than H100 for int8 inference on small models. Recommend positioning as low-cost option for batch/embeddings and development environments. Not recommended for high p99 low-latency SLAs.

devrel: Routing behavior?

sophia: Routing: region_affinity=preferred, cost_tier=very_low. Pools will be considered only after local preferred pools, unless caller explicitly sets `preferred_pool=a2` in request. No automatic rescheduling of existing reservations.

ops: Autoscale + monitoring?

sre-bot: Autoscaling: min_replicas=1, scale_step=2, cooldown=120s. Monitoring dashboard: /dashboards/dedicated-a2-pilot (internal). Alerts: p95 latency > 300ms or GPU util > 80% for 2 consecutive mins.

sophia: Reservation CLI example:
```
# reserve 3 cards for 7 days in ca-central-1a
rw-cli dedicated reserve --pool dedicated-a2-ca-central-1a --count 3 --duration 7d --compute-credits-override=false
```

devrel: We'll add a short FAQ and sample code snippet for preferring A2 in SDK.

sophia: TL;DR: new A2 Dedicated pools in eu-north-1a and ca-central-1a; 7d min reservations; compute-credits used for soft-burst to protect reserved slots; pilot watch 7d. Ping ops/sophia for access or exceptions.
